PMC is a full-text archive that includes articles from journals reviewed and selected by NLM for archiving (current and historical), as well as individual articles collected for archiving in compliance with funder policies.

- Bookshelf
The final component of PubMed is citations for books and some individual chapters available on Bookshelf.

ABG Acid-Base eval walks a clinician through a stepwise approach to analyse ABG's and electrolytes in order to arrive at acid-base disorders and diagnostic ideas about ill patients.  It is based mainly upon a worksheet developed by Dr. Erik Rupard from the medical literature.  This tool not only yields answers, but just as importantly teaches the stepwise thinking process and the necessary concepts along the way.  A clinician or learner will wind up with good information that assists patient care and should wind up a little smarter and more able to do it with less assistance the next time.  It is a great support for those of us clinicians who use these tests only occasionally and don't have it memorized.   The differential diagnoses include the classic mnemonics like MUDPILERS, CHAMPS, CLEVER PD, and HARDUPS, with explanations and examples.

The app addresses such common questions as:

    * What are common causes of metabolic acidosis? respiratory alkalosis?
    * How do I calculate predicted pCO2? corrected bicarbonate?
    * What is the primary acid-base disorder?
    * Are additional acid-base disorders present, and if so, what are they?

This app is written and intended for practicing clinicians like internists, family physicians, ER docs, cardiologists, pulmonologists, intensivists, and hospitalists; for resident physician trainees; for medical students; and of course for other clinician colleagues like NP's and PA's.  As an educator and clinician, I am interested in feedback and I would be grateful for guidance on improving the tool.

Notes of importance:
- many thresholds and cutoffs are arbitrary and debatable, so you will have to use judgment to interpret which disorders are present and to what extent when suggested by the app
- the app facilitates you to evaluate the data.  If you make a mistake, the app will not argue with you.  It will, at the end, offer to compare your work to the disorders that the app finds using the same algorithm
- patients are more than the sums of their numbers and data, and they are often unique individuals.  Use this information as a starting point in the evaluation of your patient and always do your own thinking!

Esta aplicación ha sido diseñada para facilitar el acceso y gestión de su información médica del Portal del paciente.
¿Qué es el Portal del Paciente?
El Portal del Paciente es un espacio personal desde el que podrá acceder a su historial médico, pruebas diagnósticas, informes clínicos, gestionar citas médicas y tener un seguimiento sin esperas ni desplazamientos.
Está destinada a los pacientes del grupo Quirónsalud o a cualquier usuario que desee darse de alta como nuevo paciente.
El grupo Quirónsalud se preocupa de su salud y bienestar, por ello ha lanzado esta aplicación con la intención de acercar y estrechar la relación paciente médico para poder proporcionar un servicio de mayor calidad.
Las funcionalidades principales de esta App son:
- Solicitar cita previa pudiendo consultar los huecos disponibles para cada médico.
- Consultar, modificar o cancelar las citas concertadas.
- Notificaciones y recordatorio de citas.
- Consultar y cumplimentar las tareas pendientes que su médico le haya programado, cómo pedir cita online o rellenar formularios.
- Consultar y descargar los resultados e informes de sus pruebas. 
- Consultar y visualizar imágenes diagnósticas
- Consultar sus informes clínicos e históricos de formularios realizados pudiendo filtrarlos por fecha o especialidad.
- Comunicación directa con su médico.
- Calculadoras y herramientas de salud.
- En la sección Bienestar puedes consultar la evolución de tus indicadores de salud y estilo de vida y permite sincronizarse con tus datos de actividad física de HealthKit app (Salud). Se solicitará el permiso de acceso de lectura de HealthKit.
La aplicación requiere conexión a internet para poder acceder a sus datos. De momento no todos los hospitales del grupo se encuentran activos, aunque se irán incorporando a corto / medio plazo.
